# Video engine wire frames both sides must agree on, as "<name> <hex>" lines.
#
# The client frames are what server/video_protocol.py's serialize_message
# writes, and runtime/video/protocol/VideoProtocol.cpp must decode them; the
# events are what VideoProtocol.cpp's serializeVideoEvent writes, and
# server/video_protocol.py must decode them. Cancel, Error and StartFailed
# are the engine protocol's payloads (protocol_golden.txt) under the video
# stream's header. dev/tests/engine/video_protocol_test.cpp and
# dev/tests/server/test_video_protocol.py build the messages;
# runtime/video/protocol/VideoProtocol.hpp describes every layout.

# Client frames.
